analysis.hypothesis: The reference model performs torch.stack along dim=0 followed by clone. The model_new must preserve the same interface and state_dict keys (empty). Two custom ops are needed: custom_stack (equivalent to torch.stack with dim=0 for exactly two tensors) and custom_clone (deep copy preserving strides). All custom ops will be implemented in later CUDA stages, so model_new.py only defines ModelNew using cuda_extension calls.
evidence: model.py forward: x = torch.stack((x, y), dim=0); x = torch.clone(x); return x
task_contract.json reference_calls: torch.stack args (x, y), keywords dim=0; torch.clone args (x), keywords {}
checkpoints step_001 (stack result), step_002 (clone result), step_003 (return clone result) all have shape [2,512,3,256,256], dtype torch.float32, device cuda:0, same strides
changes: Define ModelNew with no parameters (state_dict empty) to match reference.
Implement forward using custom_stack then custom_clone, preserving order and shapes.
Implement debug_forward yielding checkpoints step_001, step_002, step_003 with same values as normal forward.
Provide operator_contract describing custom_stack and custom_clone with exact dtype/shape/strides semantics.

analysis.hypothesis: The reference model only performs stack and clone, both of which can be implemented as memory copies. A single custom CUDA kernel can efficiently handle the stacking with the required layout, and cudaMemcpyAsync or a copy kernel handles clone. Dtype is float32 only, input/output on CUDA, non-contiguous inputs are supported by contract but reference inputs are contiguous; we still implement stride-aware indexing for correctness.
evidence: model_new.py calls cuda_extension.custom_stack(x, y) then cuda_extension.custom_clone(x), with no other ops.
custom_ops_contract.json specifies custom_stack with two float32 CUDA tensors of shape [512,3,256,256], output shape [2,512,3,256,256], and custom_clone to produce identical copy.
task_contract.json output stride [100663296, 196608, 65536, 256, 1] corresponds to contiguous [2,512,3,256,256] tensor.
SKILL.md requires kernels in kernels/custom_ops.cu with launchers only, no torch/ATen dependencies, and no other .cu files.
changes: Implement kernels/custom_ops.cu with CUDA kernels: custom_stack_kernel for stacking (writing two planes) and custom_copy_kernel for clone.
Provide extern "C" launchers custom_stack_launcher and custom_clone_launcher with raw pointers, dims, strides, and cudaStream_t.
Use grid-stride loops and linear indexing to support arbitrary strides and large tensors.
Handle non-contiguous inputs via explicit strides; for output use contiguous layout matching reference.
Check for errors after kernel launches with cudaGetLastError.
No torch headers, no pybind, no Tensor types in .cu.

analysis.hypothesis: 需要生成 kernels/custom_ops_binding.cpp，为 custom_stack 和 custom_clone 提供 PyTorch 接口，调用 custom_ops.cu 中导出的 launcher。绑定中完成 tensor 检查、stride 数组准备、输出分配、stream 获取和 pybind 注册。
evidence: custom_ops.cu 导出了 custom_stack_launcher(const float*, const float*, float*, const int64_t*, const int64_t*, const int64_t*, int64_t, cudaStream_t) 和 custom_clone_launcher(const float*, float*, int64_t, cudaStream_t)。
Python 调用为 cuda_extension.custom_stack(x, y) 和 cuda_extension.custom_clone(x)，参数顺序和默认值已在 contract 中给出。
绑定文件不得包含 CUDA kernel，需要包含 torch/types.h 和 torch/csrc/utils/pybind.h，使用 c10::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream() 获取当前流。
必须处理 stride 数组以支持任意 stride（契约中 layout 为 supports strides），并分配输出张量（torch::empty）设置适当的 strides。
changes: 创建 kernels/custom_ops_binding.cpp，包含必需的 PyTorch 头文件和 binding_registry.h。
声明外部 C 函数 custom_stack_launcher 和 custom_clone_launcher。
实现 custom_stack_forward(torch::Tensor x, torch::Tensor y)：检查 CUDA、dtype、shape；获取 strides 到 std::vector<int64_t> 并传递给 launcher；分配输出张量（形状 [2,512,3,256,256]，strides 固定为连续）；调用 launcher 后返回张量。
实现 custom_clone_forward(torch::Tensor x)：检查 CUDA、dtype、shape；使用 torch::empty_strided 复制输入 strides 以保证 deep copy 保持 strides；调用 launcher 进行复制。
注册函数 register_custom_ops(py::module& m)，使用 m.def 定义 custom_stack 和 custom_clone 并设置 py::arg 名称；使用 REGISTER_BINDING 宏自动注册。
